verdict.rationale: Unit's docs confirm virtual and physical card issuance tied to accounts, with configurable spend controls, real-time authorization, and lifecycle management (unit-docs-3, unit-docs-13, unit-docs-26), all via the same API/platform as accounts. However, none of the evidence explicitly confirms digital wallet (Apple Pay/Google Pay) support, and probes show the actual API/OpenAPI docs returning 404s rather than corroborating implementation details. Missing for 10: explicit digital wallet provisioning evidence, working API reference/OpenAPI docs, independent hands-on confirmation.
